description: This file defines an abstract base class 'AbstractComponent' for React components that integrates with application-specific events, lifecycle management, and MobX reactions in a web application context.

classes.name: AbstractComponent
classes.description: An abstract React component class that manages application event subscriptions and MobX reactions, providing a structured lifecycle and extensibility for derived components.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Cleans up event subscriptions and resets properties when the component is unmounted.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: React lifecycle method called after component is mounted, initiates app event observers.

methods.name: componentWillUnmount
methods.description: React lifecycle method called before component is unmounted, calls deinit for cleanup.

methods.name: viewControllerManager
methods.description: Getter to access the application's ViewControllerManager instance.

methods.name: autorun
methods.description: Adds a MobX autorun reaction to the component.

methods.name: addAppEventObserver
methods.description: Subscribes to application events and binds respective handlers.

methods.name: onAppEvent
methods.description: Placeholder method for handling application events; meant to be overridden.

methods.name: onAppStart
methods.description: Optional async override for handling app start event.

methods.name: onLocalDataLoaded
methods.description: Optional override for handling local data loaded event.

methods.name: onAppLaunch
methods.description: Optional async override for handling app launch event.

methods.name: onAppKeyChange
methods.description: Optional async override for handling app key change event.

methods.name: onAppIncrementalSync
methods.description: Optional override for handling incremental sync completion.

methods.name: onAppFullSync
methods.description: Optional override for handling full sync completion.
